project.name: ai-work
project.objective: build an AI pull-request review system with parallel specialist agents, a redis based queue for GitHub 200 OK webhook, and Tiger cloud

assumptions.text: Dedup of redelivered webhooks uses the X-GitHub-Delivery id; LLM budget per PR is bounded (to be set in NFR).

decisions.title: Stack
decisions.text: Python + FastAPI; Redis-backed queue; Tiger Cloud (Postgres/TimescaleDB with pgvector); Claude API for agents.

decisions.title: Scope v1
decisions.text: Single GitHub App / single repo. Webhook handler verifies signature, enqueues to Redis, returns 200 OK immediately; workers process asynchronously.

decisions.title: Specialist agents
decisions.text: Parallel agents: security, correctness/bugs, tests and documentation. Results aggregated into one summary review plus inline comments.

decisions.title: Tiger Cloud usage
decisions.text: Store PRs, findings, job runs, timings; events as hypertables (day partitioning) with continuous-aggregate rollups; pr_cost and agent_health views; pgvector embeddings for RAG context.

decisions.title: Replace stale tasks T-01..T-04
decisions.text: Architecture PDF (.genesis/Designing_and_building_a_PR_review_multi_agent_system.pdf) required spec rewrite (4 specialists, ARQ, LangGraph, HITL gate, hybrid retrieval, dashboard). CLI cannot edit tasks, so the four unstarted queued tasks (no proof, no attempts) were removed from project.json and re-added with corrected requirement links.

decisions.title: Confidence threshold
decisions.text: Reviews with overall confidence below 0.80 route to the human queue; CRITICAL always escalates.

decisions.title: Per-PR LLM budget
decisions.text: Soft cap: warn at $1, hard stop at $3 per PR; both recorded as events.

decisions.title: Retry policy
decisions.text: 3 tries with exponential backoff (ARQ max_tries=3); dead-letter after the limit.

decisions.title: Models per agent
decisions.text: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) for the security agent only; Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) for quality, tests, docs and aggregator.

decisions.title: Embeddings
decisions.text: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small at 256 dimensions for code_chunks and queries.

decisions.title: code_chunks indexing
decisions.text: Full index once at install, then incremental re-index of changed files only, keyed by content hash (skip unchanged chunks to avoid re-embedding cost). Interpreted from 'industry recommended, low cost'.
decisions.source: user answers 2026-10-25 (Q6, interpreted as A + content-hash incremental)

decisions.title: Hosting
decisions.text: Railway for API, worker and Next.js dashboard; managed Redis (Railway/Upstash).

decisions.title: Widen task scopes
decisions.text: T-01..T-07 scopes widened to include app, tests, requirements.txt (tests and dependency file are inherent to every task; original scopes were too narrow and the CLI cannot edit scope). Edited project.json directly with user approval.

decisions.title: Overall confidence formula
decisions.text: Weighted mean of finding confidence, weights by severity (CRITICAL 5, HIGH 4, MEDIUM 3, LOW 2, INFO 1). No findings = 1.0.

decisions.title: Dispute evidence threshold
decisions.text: Feedback changes behavior only after 3 disputes in the same category (per repo). Interpreted effect: muting findings of severity MEDIUM or lower in that category; CRITICAL/HIGH never muted.
decisions.source: user answer Q2=A; effect is my interpretation

decisions.title: Posting idempotency
decisions.text: Record github_review_id in reviews (Tiger Cloud) under a row lock; skip posting if set. Known gap: crash between GitHub post and DB write can duplicate on retry (option B, checking GitHub, deferred).

decisions.title: Unplaceable findings
decisions.text: Findings whose line is not in the PR diff go into the summary body instead of inline comments.

decisions.title: OpenTelemetry in T-07
decisions.text: Use OpenTelemetry for traces in T-07 as an additive layer: new module plus wrapping existing seams (llm callable, run_review) from outside. Do not edit T-01 ingress files. Tiger Cloud agent_events stays the source of truth; OTel is the standard trace view. Backend choice deferred to T-07 start.

decisions.title: T-07 choices
decisions.text: OTel traces to console by default (switch to OTLP via OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, no code change). Failed LLM calls retried 3 times with exponential backoff. Circuit breaker: open after 5 failures in 60s, 30s cooldown. Dead-letter queue is a Redis list (no schema change).

decisions.title: T-08 choices
decisions.text: Dashboard uses a dedicated read-only DB role (least privilege: rollups + review tables only, no raw events/code). No login (local use) but production refuses to start without DASHBOARD_PASSWORD, to avoid accidental public exposure. Approval queue is read-only (no approve/reject buttons in v1).

decisions.title: Provider switch to Google AI Studio (supersedes Q4 and Q5)
decisions.text: No Anthropic or OpenAI key available. Chat agents use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (default Google AI Studio gemini-2.5-pro for security, gemini-2.5-flash for others); embeddings use Google gemini-embedding-001 at 256 dims via native batchEmbedContents. One key LLM_API_KEY. Models, base URL configurable by env; Anthropic client kept. Free-tier models are costed at 0 so budget caps only bite on priced models. Free tier may use prompts to improve Google products.

decisions.title: Wiring choices (T-10)
decisions.text: Index only files touched by the PR (incremental by content hash). Checkpoints in Tiger Cloud Postgres (langgraph-checkpoint-postgres), not Redis. Job queue on a hosted Redis (Redis Cloud free; Upstash free rejected: ARQ polling exceeds 500K commands/month). Escalated reviews handled by a small CLI to list/approve/reject, which posts on approve.

tasks.outcome: Ingress: FastAPI webhook verifies HMAC, filters PR events, dedups by delivery id, enqueues via ARQ/Redis, 200 OK; ARQ worker skeleton with retries/timeouts
Tiger Cloud schema: review truth tables, code_chunks, agent_events 1-day hypertable, agent_health_1m and pr_cost_hourly continuous aggregates
Hybrid retrieval: 256-dim embeddings, DiskANN ANN + GIN full-text, RRF merge to top-k, procedural/episodic context
Finding contract and LangGraph orchestrator: four parallel specialists via Send, typed state, Redis checkpoints, failure isolation, per-PR budget, injection-safe prompts
Aggregator (merge, dedup, overall confidence), confidence-weighted HITL gate with CRITICAL escalation, dispute/feedback path with evidence threshold
Idempotent posting of summary review plus inline comments via GitHub API
Reliability and observability: node timeouts, backoff, circuit breakers, dead-letter queue, trace events with prompt version and context ids
Next.js dashboard for cost, agent health, escalation rate and approval queue; Railway deploy config
Free-tier model provider: OpenAI-compatible chat client (Google AI Studio or OpenRouter) and Google embeddings at 256 dims, configurable by env; Anthropic client kept as an option

Wire the worker end to end: fetch PR diff and changed files, incrementally index them, retrieve context, run the graph with Postgres checkpoints, save review and events, post or park for a human; CLI to list/approve/reject queued reviews
